filter.label: Filter
list.timeline_sub: Newest first, each node labelled with its branch
list.branch_sub: Indented by branch relation; ● marks the current node (only the newest auto backup is shown)
list.no_games: No games to show yet; add a game to get started.
list.empty_filtered: Empty: no backups match the current filters
sel.title: Selected backup
sel.hint: Click a backup node in the timeline
sel.current: ● Current node: later backups and branches continue from here
sel.not_current: Not the current node · {size} · use 「Restore this node」 to continue here
task.title: Task status
task.hint: Schedules are configured per game; edit them in Game settings or under Scheduled tasks in the workspace.
schedule.title: Scheduled tasks
schedule.subtitle: Only games with a schedule are listed; intervals are per game, and the recommended place to edit them is Game settings → Schedule.
schedule.all_configured: Every game already has a schedule; edit an existing task instead.
schedule.no_eligible: No game can be scheduled yet: add a save location first, or edit an existing task.
schedule.remove_message: Delete the scheduled task of {name}? Existing backups are kept.
dialog.restore_safety_hint: Back up the current save state before restoring, so you can return to it at any time (safety points appear in the timeline view only).
dialog.restore_process: A game process is running ({matches}); restoring now may corrupt saves. Please quit the game first.
dialog.restore_invalid: The backup snapshot is incomplete; restore cancelled
dialog.unchanged_backup: The current save is identical to 「{backup}」, so no new backup was created.
dialog.rename_label: Backup name (empty keeps the default name)
dialog.describe_prompt: The description appears on the backup card; up to {limit} characters.
dialog.delete_branch_message: 「{title}」is the root of a branch; deleting it also removes every backup under that branch ({count} nodes). This cannot be undone. Continue?
dialog.keep_auto_prompt: How many auto backups should be kept? (1-{max})
dialog.schedule_add_prompt: Pick the game to schedule (type to filter):
dialog.schedule_add_note: Tip: this window is mainly for a unified overview; to schedule one game, prefer Game settings → Schedule.
dialog.schedule_add_blocked: These games have no save location yet, so they cannot be scheduled (add a save path in Game settings): {names}
settings.title: Settings
settings.appearance_hint: Switch between the light and dark theme; applied immediately.
settings.language_hint: Switching rebuilds the whole UI in the new language and re-probes localized game names (names without a translation keep the detected one).
settings.shortcut_hint: Click a key field and press the new combination: it must contain Win, Ctrl, Alt or Shift and at least one letter (digits clash with native Windows shortcuts, so they are not supported).
settings.note: Full settings such as backup folder and log location are not available yet.
config.reset: The config file was invalid, so it was reset to defaults (the original is kept as config.json.invalid)
dialog.schedule_prompt: Use intervals such as 30m / 2h / 1d; leave empty and save to remove the schedule. Current: {current}
dialog.schedule_paused_disabled: Saved the schedule for "{name}"; the game is disabled, so the task stays paused and starts once you enable it.
game.no_locations_hint: This game has no save location configured; add one manually first.
hotkey.err_too_few: No key was recognised, please press the combination again
hotkey.err_no_modifier: The combination must contain Win, Ctrl, Alt or Shift
hotkey.err_no_letter: The combination needs at least one letter key (a-z), for example Win+Alt+S
hotkey.err_unknown_key: Unsupported key: only Win/Ctrl/Alt/Shift and letters a-z are allowed
hotkey.game_inactive: Hotkey ignored: the current game is not enabled or is archived
error.no_locations_backup: Cannot back up: no save location is configured
error.no_locations_schedule: {name} has no save location yet, so a scheduled backup cannot be created: add a save path in Game settings first.
error.disabled_game_schedule: "{name}" is disabled, so its scheduled backup cannot be enabled: enable the game first.
error.archived_game_schedule: "{name}" is archived, so a scheduled backup cannot be configured: unarchive it first.
error.restore_busy: Restore interrupted: a game process is running; operation cancelled
result.restore_written: Restored 「{name}」 from 「{title}」 ({files} files); the current node now points at this backup, and later backups and branches continue from there
result.restore_canceled: Restore cancelled; the original save was not modified
result.location_deleted: Moved {path} to the system trash ({count} files) and removed the save location record
detail.subtitle: Manage original save locations and local backups
loc.err_wrong_kind: Path type does not match the setting: {path}
loc.add_prompt: Pick or type a {kind} path (will be normalized and validated):
loc.delete_origin_prompt:
The following location will be moved to the system trash (never deleted permanently):
{path}
It contains {files} files ({size}).
Type the game name 「{name}」 to confirm:
loc.delete_blocked_missing: Path does not exist; nothing to delete: {path}
loc.delete_blocked_not_absolute: Path is not absolute; refusing to delete: {path}
loc.delete_blocked_drive_root: Deleting a drive root is not allowed: {path}
loc.delete_blocked_user_home: Deleting the user home directory is not allowed: {path}
loc.delete_blocked_protected: This path belongs to the app; refusing to delete: {path}
loc.delete_blocked_contains_protected: This path contains the app backup folder; refusing to delete: {path}
error.duplicate_location: This game already has this location: {path}
error.not_available: This feature is not available yet
error.operation_busy: Another backup is already running; please wait
error.meta_update_failed: Could not save the backup details: {reason}
error.location_delete_failed: Could not delete the original save location: {reason}
error.location_delete_confirm: The confirmation name does not match the game name; nothing was deleted
result.backup_canceled: Backup cancelled; no node was written
result.renamed: Updated the name and description of 「{title}」
result.delete_shift: Backup deleted; later backups on the same line moved up
result.delete_cascade: Deleted the branch root and every backup under it ({count} nodes)
restore.problem_not_absolute: Target is not an absolute path; refusing to write back
restore.problem_drive_root: Target is a drive root; refusing to write back
restore.problem_user_home: Target is the user home directory; refusing to write back
restore.problem_protected: This location belongs to the app (backup folder); refusing to write back
restore.problem_contains_protected: This location contains the app backup folder; refusing to write back
restore.problem_unwritable: Target path is not writable; check permissions
restore.problem_kind_mismatch: Target kind does not match the backup (file/folder)
restore.warn_recorded_path: This location is no longer configured; the path recorded in the backup is used
restore.warn_more_locations: More save locations are configured than the backup had; the extra ones will not be restored
result.game_added_disabled: Added game 「{name}」 (disabled by default, enable it on the home page)
manage.title: Manage game
manage.delete_message: Delete game 「{name}」? Its configured save locations will be removed too. Manual backups already created are kept.
manage.backup_note: Backup folder is managed by the app; nothing to configure here: {path}
manage.no_locations: No save location configured yet. Add one with the buttons below.
discovery.hint: Scans the sources available on this platform: Steam and Epic manifests, GOG/Ubisoft entries in the Windows registry, plus the games found in your watched folders. Nothing enters your library until you confirm it.
discovery.scan_done: Scan finished: {added} new, {total} candidates in total
discovery.save_unsupported: The {platform} adapter does not support automatic detection yet; add save locations manually after importing
discovery.save_found: Inferred {count} save path(s) — editable while importing
discovery.dirs_hint: Covers games the platform clients cannot report (not installed, not signed in or custom paths); every subfolder becomes a candidate. On macOS and Linux, add games the platform manifests cannot report (for example GOG or Ubisoft) here as well.
discovery.candidates_empty: No candidates yet. Click “Rescan” on the right of the tabs to probe this machine.
discovery.empty_filtered_hint: Pending {new} · imported {imported} · ignored {ignored} — switch the filter at the top right to review the others.

dialog.home_tags_prompt: Separate tags with commas (up to 6, each up to 16 characters):
